#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script - creates a release archive of the current directory
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

set -e

# Get the current directory name
DIR_NAME=$(basename "$PWD")

# Generate timestamp for the archive name
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")

# Define the archive name
ARCHIVE_NAME="${DIR_NAME}_release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

echo "Creating release archive: ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

# Create tar.gz archive excluding node_modules and .git
tar -czvf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" \
    --exclude='node_modules' \
    --exclude='.git' \
    --exclude=".git/*" \
    --exclude="$ARCHIVE_NAME" \
    .

echo ""
echo "✓ Archive created successfully: ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
echo "  Size: $(du -h "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | cut -f1)"

    local env_file=".env.test"

    local empty_vars=()

        if [[ "$line" =~ ^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)= ]]; then

            if [[ -z "${!var_name+x}" ]]; then

        echo ""

    fi

    echo ""

    echo ""

#!/bin/bash

    --file="$OUTPUT_DIR/$ARCHIVE_NAME" \
    --exclude-vcs \
    --exclude='node_modules' \
    --exclude='releases' \
    --exclude='*.tar.gz' \
    --directory="$SCRIPT_DIR" \
    .

# Get archive size
ARCHIVE_SIZE=$(du -h "$OUTPUT_DIR/$ARCHIVE_NAME" | cut -f1)

echo "✓ Archive created successfully!"
echo "  Location: $OUTPUT_DIR/$ARCHIVE_NAME"
echo "  Size: $ARCHIVE_SIZE"

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment Script - Creates a release archive of the current directory
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories
# Validates required environment variables from .env.test

set -e

# Configuration
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
PROJECT_NAME="$(basename "$SCRIPT_DIR")"
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
ARCHIVE_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME}_release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
ENV_TEST_FILE=".env.test"

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# ============================================
# Pre-deployment Validation
# ============================================

validate_env_variables() {
    echo -e "${BLUE}=== Pre-deployment Validation ===${NC}"
    echo ""
    
    # Check if .env.test exists
    if [ ! -f "$ENV_TEST_FILE" ]; then
        echo -e "${RED}✗ Error: $ENV_TEST_FILE not found${NC}"
        echo "Please create a .env.test file with required environment variables."
        exit 1
    fi
    
    echo "Reading required variables from $ENV_TEST_FILE..."
    echo ""
    
    local missing_vars=()
    local empty_vars=()
    local validated_count=0
    
    # Read .env.test and check each variable
    while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines
        [ -z "$line" ] && continue
        
        # Skip comments (lines starting with #)
        [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
        
        # Extract variable name (before =)
        var_name=$(echo "$line" | cut -d'=' -f1 | tr -d '[:space:]')
        
        # Skip if no variable name
        [ -z "$var_name" ] && continue
        
        # Check if environment variable is set
        if [ -z "${!var_name+x}" ]; then
            missing_vars+=("$var_name")
        elif [ -z "${!var_name}" ]; then
            empty_vars+=("$var_name")
        else
            # Mask the value for security (show first 3 chars and last 2, or just asterisks for short values)
            value="${!var_name}"
            value_len=${#value}
            if [ $value_len -gt 5 ]; then
                masked_value="${value:0:3}...${value: -2}"
            else
                masked_value="****"
            fi
            echo -e "  ${GREEN}✓${NC} $var_name = $masked_value"
            ((validated_count++))
        fi
    done < "$ENV_TEST_FILE"
    
    echo ""
    
    # Report validation results
    if [ ${#missing_vars[@]} -eq 0 ] && [ ${#empty_vars[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓ All $validated_count required environment variables are set${NC}"
        return 0
    else
        if [ ${#missing_vars[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
            echo -e "${RED}✗ Missing environment variables:${NC}"
            for var in "${missing_vars[@]}"; do
                echo -e "  ${RED}• $var${NC}"
            done
            echo ""
        fi
        
        if [ ${#empty_vars[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
            echo -e "${RED}✗ Empty environment variables:${NC}"
            for var in "${empty_vars[@]}"; do
                echo -e "  ${RED}• $var${NC}"
            done
            echo ""
        fi
        
        echo -e "${YELLOW}Please set the missing/empty variables before deploying.${NC}"
        echo "Example: export VAR_NAME=value"
        exit 1
    fi
}

# ============================================
# Archive Creation
# ============================================

create_archive() {
    echo ""
    echo -e "${BLUE}=== Creating Release Archive ===${NC}"
    echo ""
    echo "Project: $PROJECT_NAME"
    echo "Output: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
    echo ""
    
    # Create the archive, excluding node_modules and .git
    # Using --exclude with tar to filter out directories
    tar -czvf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" \
        --exclude='node_modules' \
        --exclude='.git' \
        --exclude="*.tar.gz" \
        --exclude="$ARCHIVE_NAME" \
        --exclude=".env*" \
        -C "$(dirname "$SCRIPT_DIR")" \
        "$PROJECT_NAME"
    
    # Check if archive was created successfully
    if [ -f "$ARCHIVE_NAME" ]; then
        ARCHIVE_SIZE=$(du -h "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | cut -f1)
        echo ""
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓ Release archive created successfully!${NC}"
        echo "Archive: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
        echo "Size: $ARCHIVE_SIZE"
        echo ""
        echo "To extract, run: tar -xzvf $ARCHIVE_NAME"
    else
        echo -e "${RED}✗ Failed to create archive${NC}"
        exit 1
    fi
}

# ============================================
# Main Execution
# ============================================

main() {
    validate_env_variables
    create_archive
}

main
